sections.title: QoL Buffs
items: A Move Reminder has been added to the 2nd floor of each PokeCenter.

All grinding has been removed. Battling no longer grants Exp or EVs; in each area where a new Pokemon can be encountered, there is a Rare Candy Cache which can be used to level your Pokemon; Vitamins and EV Berries are available for cheap at the Goldenrod Dept. Store.

Beneath every Apricorn Tree is a Berry Pile containing 500 of a single non-useless Berry type. Berry Piles are randomized with no repeats. Lum and Sitrus are always findable (though they may be in Kanto)
Since breeding is against the Nuzlocke Rules, all Egg Moves are available at the Move Reminder if a Pokemon is fully-evolved.
Pokemon which evolve with an item have a chance to be holding that item (e.g. Pikachu -> Thunderstone); All Evolution Items are available at either the Ecruteak, Blackthorn, or Vermilion Marts
All eggs hatch after 1 cycle (~256 steps)
HMs (except Fly due to technical limitations) have been replaced by PokePagers. Some moves which were HMs are now TMs (Surf, Waterfall)
All Pokemon have a 10% chance to have their hidden ability (including enemy trainer Pokemon)
Impossible/Annoying Evolution methods have been replaced with more accessible methods (no more Time of Day evos)

sections.title: Learnsets
items: Since not every pokemon is in Gen 9 (and a select few aren't in Gen 8 either), Goldilockes' Level-Ups are determined using this priority: Gen 9 learnset -> Gen 8 Learnset -> Custom, modernized learnset

TM learnsets follow a similar logic; since the the TM list in Gen 9 is different to that of Gen 8, we developed a "bellwether" system that correlates new TM moves to older ones and then builds Gen 9-esque Machine learnsets. (e.g. if a pokemon could learn Dive in Gen 8, it can learn Flip Turn, a Gen 9 move; Body Slam -> Take Down; Breaking Swipe -> Scale Shot, etc.)

sections.title: Bosses
items: Gyms in Pokemon Goldilockes each have a Random Type Theme.
E4 ARE type-themed; Rocket Bosses, Rival, and Champion are not
Rival will always have his starter or an evo of it
Gym Leader Rewards have been enhanced to include Heart Scales and Ability-changing items.
Bosses are further broken down in the "Difficulty Scaling" section
Note: there is a good deal of overlap between a Gym Theme's Pivots and Fulcrums, so it can be unclear which is which.

sections.title: Difficulty
items: Hardcore Rules (Level Clause, Set Clause, Item Clause) are enforced by the ROM
Additional "walls" have been added to make the game more linear
Many bosses have been rebalanced
Gauntlet Mode: Traners' Pokemon are leveled to just below the current Level Cap
All Wild Pokemon levels are multiplied by 1.5

sections.title: Intentionally Inaccessible Areas
items: Safari Zone
Battle Frontier
Pokeathlon Dome
Ruins of Alph (this is due to technical issue and will be changed as soon as it is resolved. For now, enjoy the static encounter)
Embedded Tower

sections.title: Move Changes
items: Moves which ALWAYS affect Accuracy or Evasion have been removed or changed
Double Team -> +1 Speed
Smokescreen -> -1 Sp. Def
Mud Slap -> 40 BP, -1 Speed
Sand Attack -> -1 Speed
Flash, Kinesis, Acupressure, and Minimize -> REMOVED
Note: moves which have a CHANCE of affecting Accuracy or Evasion remain unchanged (Octazooka, Leaf Tornado, Night Daze, Mirror Shot, Mud Bomb, Muddy Water, Secret Power)
